reason: A mobile remote-control plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that provides QR pairing, device session management, mobile chat and session operations, and TunnelMux-backed connectivity.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供移动端远程控制、二维码配对、设备会话管理以及基于 TunnelMux 的连接能力。
summaries.en: Provides mobile remote control for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with QR pairing, device session management, chat and session operations, and TunnelMux connectivity.

capabilities: Provides a mobile web interface for remote session management and chat
Pairs mobile devices using QR codes and one-time tokens
Maintains, limits, and revokes device sessions
Communicates with a local TunnelMux control API and public tunnel endpoint
Streams live pairing and status updates using server-sent events
Proxies an allowlisted set of host API methods to mobile clients
